title: Cross-functional roadmap sync prep - Mar 2026 (personal notes)
notes:
Purpose: prep for cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Goal = align next-quarters' priorities, surface risks (latency/cost/regression), agree on rollouts + evaluations.

Context / high-level:
- We need to finalize Q2 focus areas for Hosted API + Dedicated integration points before exec review (internal deadline 2026-03-18).
- Major themes: improve p95 latency for chat workloads, reduce per-token cost for large-context customers, and formalize model onboarding/rollout process with applied-ml eval hooks.
- Capacity constraints: Dedicated pool reservations need approx sizing by end of month (affects Dedicated roadmap).

Attendees (expected):
- Product: Olivia (me), Asha (PM, Dedicated), Priya (growth lead - optional)
- Eng: Dylan (serving runtime), Raj (platform eng), Ethan (sre - oncall)
- Applied ML: Maya (evals & model onboarding), Sam (quantization experiments)

Agenda (30-45m) - proposed:
1) 5m - quick status: what shipped since last sync (small bullets)
2) 10m - priority alignment: top 3 objectives for next 6-8 weeks (product proposes, eng/ML reaction)
3) 10m - risks & capacity (hardware, Dedicated sizing, fallbacks)
4) 10m - evaluation strategy + rollout plan (canary gates, metrics, eval dataset additions)
5) 5-10m - actions + owners + timeline

Notes to self / talking points: 
- Shipped: cost dashboard v1 (console) rolled out to internal beta; streaming stability fixes for long-chat sessions (ENG-3358).
- Product proposal (my pitch):
  * Objective A: p95 latency improvement for typical chat customers by 15% via kernel selection + smarter routing (hosted).
  * Objective B: 20% reduction in per-token cost for large-context workloads using prefix caching + recommendation for 4-bit quantized variants for non-sensitive data paths.
  * Objective C: Harden model onboarding pipe: add regression eval + automatic rollback criteria to reduce quality regressions on canary.
- Why these? p95 latency is main blocker for pilot customers (higher churn risk). Cost reduction requested by two large trials (SaaS search & summarization). Onboarding regressions caused 2 incidents in last quarter.

Technical considerations (eng/ML prompts):
- Serving runtime (Dylan): can we get kernel selection experiments landed in 3 sprints? Need clarity on perf windows for different sequence lengths; might require microbench infra work (ENG-3421).
- Batching/caching tradeoffs: We need modeling of tail latency impact if we increase batch sizes; propose A/B with dynamic batching policy by customer tier.
- Quantization (Sam/Maya): 4-bit variants show ~2.2x throughput on A100 in initial tests but need quality check on prompt set "chat-long-context-v2". Add targeted evals for hallucination/regression on summaries.
- Rollout gating: suggest combined metrics: latency p95, token-cost per request, and eval-quality score delta (>= -1.5 pts triggers rollback). Need exact thresholds agreed.

Open questions to surface in sync:
- Eng: realistic timeline for kernel selection + microbench infra (Dylan). Can we commit to prototype by 2026-04-15?
- Platform: Dedicated sizing ask from two enterprise pilots - how much lead time to reserve GPUs? (Raj).
- Applied ML: how many eval prompt sets do we need to add to confidently approve 4-bit candidate for hosted vs dedicated? (Maya).
- Product: what revenue signal/threshold triggers prioritized Dedicated work vs Hosted optimization? Need input from growth/CS (Priya).

Proposed success criteria (for next checkpoint 2026-04-20):
- Kernel selection prototype + perf dashboard for top-3 model families.
- Eval suite expanded with 2 new prompt sets + baseline quality thresholds defined.
- Draft rollout playbook (canary steps, rollback triggers) + owner for automation (ENG + ML).
- Dedicated capacity request template & estimate for pilot customers.

Draft action items (capture during meeting & assign):
- Olivia: consolidate final objectives and send to execs by 2026-03-18 (once we have buy-in).
- Dylan: scope microbench infra and prototype timeline; create ENG-3421 subtask with deliverables by 2026-04-15.
- Maya/Sam: run expanded eval on 4-bit model variants against "chat-long-context-v2" and "summaries-robustness-1" sets; share results 2026-04-01.
- Raj: confirm Dedicated reservation lead times + initial sizing recommendation for pilot; share template by 2026-03-22.
- Ethan: simulate increased batching policies on staging for SLA impact; flag any SLO violations by 2026-03-29.
- Asha: coordinate with CS to surface priority customers and revenue thresholds; sync with Priya; update product-prioritization doc by 2026-03-17.

Notes on tone for sync: be concrete but flexible. Avoid getting bogged down in micro-implementation - surface implications (customer risk, cost delta, rollout complexity).

Quick links / refs to mention:
- Dashboard prototype: https://redwood.console/internal/cost-dashboard (internal)
- Jira: ENG-3421 (kernel selection), ENG-3358 (streaming fixes), ML-128 (quant perf experiments)
- Confluence: Roadmap/Hosted-API-Q2-2026 (add final objectives after this sync)
- Slack thread: #prod-eng-hosted (pin the summary after meeting)

Misc personal TODOs pre-meeting:
- Pull latest perf numbers (p50/p95) from observability for top-10 customers (ask observability team for export) - due 2026-03-06.
- Draft one-slide summary for execs (1 pager: Why these 3 objectives + topline impact estimates) - due 2026-03-10.
- Build quick table mapping customer requests -> revenue estimate -> urgency (to help Priya/Asha prioritize).

Potential fallback / alternative asks (if eng capacity limited):
- Prioritize caching + routing changes (lower engineering lift) instead of kernel selection; still yields decent cost/latency wins for targeted workloads.
- Defer Dedicated integrations, focus on Hosted optimizations for Q2 and revisit Dedicated in mid-Q3 after capacity planning.

End - will convert into meeting notes and action items after sync. Save a snapshot to Confluence and link to Jira tickets.
